## Efficient generative models for medical imaging

I am a researcher working on efficient 3D and 4D generative models, synthetic medical-image evaluation, and trustworthy research workflows.

[Research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Research notes](blog.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Current themes

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Efficient generation
Architectures and inference methods for high-resolution volumetric and temporal medical imaging.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Evaluation
Fidelity, diversity, memorisation, privacy, anatomy, and downstream utility.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Reproducible research
Practical systems that connect evidence, experiments, code, and scientific communication.
:::
